newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury to announce bill sale early today.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury to announce bill sale early today.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Friday it was moving up today's announcement about details of its planned 52-week bill sale by 1-1/2 hours to 1230 EST/1730 GMT.
A Treasury official said the change in time for today's announcement was being made because bond markets were closing early at 1400 EST/1900 GMT on the day after the Thanksgiving Day holiday.
The bills will be sold on Thursday, Dec 5.
